stage.scope: Explicit source scene pose/tie order and horizontal camera, no HUD/shadows/quake. No runtime reachability claim.

source_assets.alpha_scope: Source actor and foreground are opaque; any alpha request rejects before rendering.

contract.publication: Pending source snapshot, protected displayed refs, bank-00 queued HIGH/LOW fences, empty queue before READY, atomic VBlank map commit.

phase_manifest.source_asset_domain: Opaque source-indexed, fixed camera, immutable component palette; NOT dynamic SCREEN alpha

contract.temporary_bitmap_lifetime: Before restoration records exist, during conservative prediction only.

right.services: Legacy NMI/audio/video service is withdrawn by the retained isolated source fixture. Minimal owned NMI services only $4210; NMI disabled during native preparation/preload/commit, auto-JOY restored when idle. No audio timing claim.
right.source_movement: Actual JOY1 RIGHT, X 81 -> 81.5 through retained input-history, ground/frame, velocity and check_move pipeline

integration_changes: Captured original shared observer to avoid self-recursion after entrypoint patching.
Adapted RIGHT oracle exact source list/queue sequence for seventh source, and expanded its READY fence predicate to include the additional source.
Scoped mode-2 six-pair assertion to the faulted request; earlier ordinary requests may legitimately use seven.
Re-certification invokes full original home and RIGHT pixel/replay/source oracles; no native source step is rerun.
Added independent complete-batch/map >=10000-clock checks, exact original six-source order and all seventh HIGH/LOW timing records.
handoff.excluded_trials: v1 stopped before Mesen on observer recursion. v2 completed all native captures; its in-memory old RIGHT certifier rejected the new source post-capture. Corrected collect-suite re-certified every retained field with all original oracles and added guards.
